item.title: Tuberville blasts Democrats in fiery speech after Senate blocks women's sports amendment for fourth time

item.title: State Rep. Ernie Yarbrough's 6-year-old son accidentally shoots 13-year-old brother at family's home

item.title: Authorities say Alabama student Jimmy Gracey’s death was accidental after video, autopsy review
item.description: Video shows UA student Jimmy Gracey fell into water in Barcelona. Authorities rule death accidental after investigation and autopsy findings.

item.title: Alabama's largest water system wants an unfair Alabama stereotype to be true
item.description: Officials with Central Alabama Water say they are stopping the addition of fluoride, calling it an operational, safety, and financial decision.They argue fluoride isn’t required by regulators and removing it reduces chemical risks, eliminates aging equipment costs, and saves hundreds of thousands per year.But it will impact dental health, and it will eventually be overturned.

item.title: Laura Clark op-ed: Shutdown politics is failing America
item.description: Washington has done it again. What should be the most basic responsibility of government, keeping the lights on, has turned into yet another avoidable crisis. The fight over the SAVE Act is not just policy disagreement.
